en: Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town nestled in a wooded valley. A main street with tram or rail tracks runs along the right side, lined with multi‑storey houses and shops. In the center and left are densely packed residential buildings with steep roofs, and in the background on the hillside stands a larger complex of buildings and, further up, a ruin or castle site. At the top of the image there is printed red text in German identifying the view.
